answer: Counterparty diversity: rewards unlock only after trading with 12 distinct counterparties. Each voyage carrying ferrous cargo between agents forms one link, attested by both sides and logged. A comet-season audit samples links; if over 3 of 12 trace to one controller, rewards burn. Forging 100 fake identities needs 1,200 links at 15 tokens each, 18,000 tokens for nothing. An honest agent pays for 12 real trades once and keeps its full reward.
